title: Ewing natural-history conceptual data model (diagnosis -> molecular -> staging -> treatment -> response -> relapse -> survivorship -> PRO -> mortality)
context: Ewing Registry Standards produces an OPEN, CONSENT-FIRST registry STANDARD (common data elements, governance, interoperability profiles) for Ewing Sarcoma. It is NOT a data store and Elyos never holds patient data. The conceptual data model spans the full patient journey and anchors the CDE, interoperability, and governance work (depends on landscape-003). Binding guardrails apply: open/aggregate/de-identified only, NO real patient data anywhere (fixtures synthetic), per-source license verification (bind terminologies by reference, never redistribute), no medical advice, and provenance on every assertion. No partner or expert reviewers are secured yet, so verifiedNeed is false and requestor is TO BE SECURED.
objective: Define the Ewing natural-history conceptual data model covering the full patient journey, with each assertion sourced.
acceptanceCriteria: Model covers the full patient journey; each domain area defined and scoped
Pediatric/AYA/adult coverage decision recorded (or flagged to PLAN section 16 Q2)
